operation.description:
Gets a specific self-hosted runner configured in an organization.

Authenticated users must have admin access to the organization to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint. If the repository is private, the `repo` scope is also required.
operation.summary: Get a self-hosted runner for an organization

#/components/parameters/org.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/org.name: org

#/components/parameters/runner-id.description: Unique identifier of the self-hosted runner.
#/components/parameters/runner-id.name: runner_id

os.description: The Operating System of the runner.

runner_group_id.description: The ID of the runner group.

version.description: The version of the GitHub Actions Runner software. This is only set if the runner has connected to the service at least once.

#/components/schemas/runner-label.description: A label for a self hosted runner

type.description: The type of label. Read-only labels are applied automatically when the runner is configured.

#/components/schemas/runner-label.title: Self hosted runner label
